_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the SCP: Secret Laboratory and Exiled eggs in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: SCP: Secret Laboratory
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The multiplayer horror game of escaping the SCP Foundation. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with the Exiled plugin framework if you want it.
startup: v=; [ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && v=validate; if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $v +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; exec ./LocalAdmin {{SERVER_PORT}} --acceptEULA --useDefault --noSetCursor --noTerminalTitle --disableTrueColor

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SCP: Secret Laboratory. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 996560) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously, and Exiled when
# asked. Configs and plugins in .config are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-996560}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# Exiled, the plugin framework, when asked. It goes where the game looks for
# it, in .config; its own files are replaced, plugins and configs kept.
extra=""
loader=".config/SCP Secret Laboratory/LabAPI/plugins/global/Exiled.Loader.dll"
if [ "${EXILED:-0}" = 1 ]; then
    repo=ExMod-Team/EXILED
    want="${EXILED_VERSION:-latest}"
    if ! tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want" 2>/dev/null) && ! tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "v$want" 2>/dev/null); then
        [ "$want" = latest ] && fail "GitHub can't be reached right now to download Exiled. Reinstall to try again."
        fail "Exiled has no version $want. Set Exiled version to latest, or to one of its releases, such as $(gh-release tag "$repo" latest 2>/dev/null || echo v9.15.3)."
    fi
    gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk '$1 == "Exiled.tar.gz" { f = 1 } END { exit !f }' ||
        fail "Exiled $tag has no server download. Choose another version."
    mkdir -p .config
    if [ "$(cat .config/EXILED/.raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ] && [ -f "$loader" ]; then
        echo "Exiled $tag is already installed."
    else
        echo "Downloading Exiled $tag"
        work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
        rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
        trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
        gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" Exiled.tar.gz "$work/exiled.tar.gz" || fail "The Exiled download failed. Reinstall to try again."
        tar -xzf "$work/exiled.tar.gz" -C .config || fail "The Exiled download is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
        echo "$tag" > .config/EXILED/.raptor-version
    fi
    extra=" with Exiled $tag"
elif [ -f .config/EXILED/.raptor-version ] && [ -f "$loader" ]; then
    # Exiled turned off: unload it, keeping its plugins for later.
    rm -f "$loader" .config/EXILED/.raptor-version
    echo "Exiled is off, so its loader was removed. Its plugins and configs are kept."
fi
echo "Installed SCP: Secret Laboratory build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}$extra."

variables.name: Exiled
variables.description: Install the Exiled plugin framework; put plugins in .config/EXILED/Plugins. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Exiled version
variables.description: The Exiled release to install, such as v9.15.3, or latest for the newest full release.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
